_comment: The tailored CV for energy-infrastructure work. Every string here is either a resume highlight copied verbatim or prose about facts the resume already states: lib/matt-site.nix fails the build on anything it cannot find in resume.json, so this file selects and orders, it cannot invent.
title: Energy asset manager and risk analyst
bio: I ran the numbers behind a solar portfolio above USD 100M for four years: yield and valuation models that satisfied bank auditors, due diligence on O&M contracts, and financial models for a dozen projects of USD 4-5M each. Since 2020 I have built risk-adjusted PPA and weather-derivative models for energy companies, and acted as risk manager for gas storage and swing trading at a German energy trader. I write the software those numbers run on, because a model nobody can reproduce is not evidence.
